Product Features

  • Product Details: This white and wood-colored TV cabinet is a moderate size, fits any home style, and combines functionality and fashion. The size is 160 x 40 x 42 cm and can be perfectly integrated into any corner of the house.
  • Large Storage Space: The three-layer TV cabinet gives you enough space to display various accessories or items such as magazines, books, or other living room utensils, keeping the living room neat and organized
  • Modern TV Stand: The LED TV stand is made of chipboard wood, with a stable overall structure and a load capacity of up to 40kg. The glass shelf is designed to weigh 10-15 kg. Thanks to LED lighting and high-quality workmanship, this TV for the living room becomes the entertainment center of your home and is robust enough to last for many years.
  • Dimmable LED Lamp: Our LED lamp comes with a remote control for various lighting effects, 16 colors and 4 flashing modes, providing mood light to create a warm and pleasant living room atmosphere. With a TV stand, you can create the atmosphere that suits your desires, whether you want to relax, get together for a cozy get-together, or work late into the night.
  • Two Drawers: Two large drawers in the middle allow for convenient storage of everyday items such as DVDs, and can also be used to store items that are not frequently used to keep the living room clean and tidy.
  • High Quality: With solid structure made of high-quality laminated chipboard, it ensures stability and durability without serious wobbling and moving.
  • Versatile and versatile: this piece of furniture can be used as a TV cabinet to place the TV, but it can also be used as task lighting to facilitate reading or enhance the ambience of the room. Our TV stands are ideal for decorating your home.
  • Presentation Function: The solid top of the TV stand is perfect for displaying decorative items, picture frames, or potted plants.
  • Easy installation: All mounting accessories included. According to the instructions, everything can be assembled without any problems
  • Note: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!

Descriptions

Description

This TV cabinet (160 x 40 x 42 cm) in white and natural wood colour is made of high-quality chipboard. The three-layer shelf is equipped with two practical drawers that can be used to store books, DVDs and other items to keep the living room tidy. Its modern design includes a 40 kg LED TV stand and a 10-15 kg load-bearing glass shelf with space for displaying decorations or green plants. The highlight is the remote-controlled, adjustable 16-color LED atmosphere light, which supports 4 flashing modes. It can be used as a home entertainment center or converted into a work and reading corner. The product comes in two packages and comes with a simple assembly tool. It combines stability, versatility and stylish aesthetics and suits all living styles.

LED Light
